name: Retro Computing
pitch: A nostalgic, slightly mischievous systems talk told from a 1990 desktop, where every idea opens in its own window.

illustration.medium: flat vector, 1980s beige-computer UI illustration on light grey
illustration.line: 3px strokes, chunky bitmap-adjacent edges, slightly blocky corners
illustration.shapes: simple dialog boxes, chunky icons, and system-alert motifs with hard rectangular frames
illustration.texture: none, or a faint pixel/dither pattern for shading
illustration.palette_use: light grey background dominant, near-black ink, one deep blue accent used for the active or highlighted element
illustration.mood: nostalgic beige-box computing, deadpan system-alert humor
illustration.avoid: gradients, glossy modern UI, rounded corners, photorealism, soft shadows
